weekLabel.zh: 本周更新 · 9 月 21 日 – 9 月 27 日

title.zh: Rockstar 更新官方 Mod 指引：单机改装仍被容忍，付费与多人都被收进 Creator 平台
title.en: Rockstar updates official mod guidelines: single-player tolerated, monetisation pulled into its Creator Platform

summary.zh: 官网 Community Resources 下的 Mod Guidelines 页面更新（页面日期 9 月 10 日），覆盖含 GTA6 在内的全线作品。PC 单机改装在非商业、不干扰线上、不跨作搬运 IP 的前提下继续可行；剧情扩展、跨作品混搭、未授权移植与 Creator 平台之外的商业化全部被禁。
summary.en: Rockstar's Mod Guidelines page (dated Sep 10) now applies across its catalogue, GTA 6 included. PC single-player mods survive under strict non-commercial conditions, while story expansions, cross-title mashups, unofficial ports and any monetisation outside the licensed Creator Platform are barred.

title.zh: 官方专辑《GTA VI: The Album》公布：34 首原创曲目 11 月 19 日同步发售
title.en: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album announced — 34 original tracks landing November 19

summary.zh: Rockstar 与 Atlantic Records 合作推出官方专辑，34 首为游戏创作的曲目与 GTA6 同日发售，Yung Lean、Travis Scott、Future、Metro Boomin、Morgan Wallen、Keith Richards 在列，六首先行单曲已上线。实体版分 CD 19.98、黑胶 49.98、限量充液黑胶 124.98 美元。
summary.en: Made with Atlantic Records, the 34-track companion album ships alongside GTA VI on November 19. Six singles are streaming now, and CD, standard vinyl and a $124.98 limited liquid-filled vinyl are up for pre-order.

title.zh: Take-Two 股东大会：发售时不预期 recurring spending，PC 版依旧不松口
title.en: Take-Two AGM: no recurrent spending expected at launch, PC version still unannounced

summary.zh: Zelnick 称本次发售不预期出现鲨鱼卡式持续付费收入，发售端就是单机；PC 平台"越来越重要"但无版本无日期。被股东当面质疑多年延期时，他搬出 2007 年至今营收与股价数据逐条反驳。
summary.en: Zelnick said "no recurrent consumer spending anticipated with regard to this launch" and offered no date or window for PC. He also pushed back hard on an investor's charge of years of delays, citing growth since 2007.

title.zh: Rockstar 开发主管 Rob Nelson：GTA6 是团队史上"最大、最深、最密集、最复杂"的世界
title.en: Rockstar's Rob Nelson: GTA 6 is the studio's "biggest, deepest, densest, most complex" world yet

summary.zh: Nelson 向 IGN 表示，GTA6 延续《荒野大镖客 2》"打造完全实现且感觉一致的世界"的设计路径，同时在设计层面既是 GTA5 的续作也是 RDR2 的续作——杰森的"死神之眼"与生物收集等机制都来自后者。
summary.en: Speaking to IGN, Nelson framed GTA 6 as the continuation of the Red Dead Redemption 2 design philosophy taken further — "the biggest, deepest, densest, most complex world" the studio has built.

title.zh: 东京电玩展 GTA6 展台开门十分钟即限流；听证会材料称 32 人在线格式是"公司最高机密"
title.en: TGS queue caps within ten minutes; tribunal filings call GTA 6 Online's 32-player format a closely guarded secret

summary.zh: TGS 现场 GTA6 展台队伍在开放约十分钟后因满员关闭，热度可见一斑。另一边，苏格兰格拉斯哥的听证会材料提到 GTA6 的 32 人在线格式，Rockstar 法律文件将其形容为"公司最高机密之一"——但这是庭审材料，不是官方规格。
summary.en: The GTA 6 booth line at Tokyo Game Show closed to new entries roughly ten minutes after opening. Meanwhile, Glasgow tribunal filings reference a 32-player online format for GTA VI, described in Rockstar's submissions as one of the company's most closely guarded secrets — court material, not an official spec.
